# ChartThemeDefinition

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Composable custom theme object extending a built-in preset.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`axisColor`](#axiscolor): Axis line and tick label colour.
- [`axisFrame`](#axisframe): Whether to draw axis frame lines around the plot area.
- [`axisLineWidth`](#axislinewidth): Stroke width of axis lines in points.
- [`backgroundColor`](#backgroundcolor): Optional chart background colour override.
- [`barCornerRadius`](#barcornerradius): Default rounded corner radius on bars in points.
- [`extends`](#extends): Built-in preset to inherit unspecified theme fields from.
- [`flowLegend`](#flowlegend): Whether to lay out legend items in a wrapping flow row.
- [`fontFamily`](#fontfamily): Default chart font family.
- [`gridLineColor`](#gridlinecolor): Gridline stroke colour.
- [`gridLineStyle`](#gridlinestyle): Gridline stroke style (`solid`, `dashed`, or `none`).
- [`legendTextColor`](#legendtextcolor): Legend item label text colour.
- [`measuredLabels`](#measuredlabels): Whether to measure tick labels accurately for layout and spacing.
- [`pdfTextBaseline`](#pdftextbaseline): Whether to use PDF-aligned text baseline offsets.
- [`roundedLegendSwatches`](#roundedlegendswatches): Whether to draw rounded square swatches in legends.
- [`seriesDashPatterns`](#seriesdashpatterns): Ordered dash patterns assigned to line series.
- [`seriesMarkerShapes`](#seriesmarkershapes): Ordered marker shapes assigned to series.
- [`seriesPalette`](#seriespalette): Ordered colour palette assigned to series without an explicit colour.
- [`seriesPatterns`](#seriespatterns): Ordered fill patterns assigned to series (used by monochrome print themes).
- [`styledGeometry`](#styledgeometry): Whether to enable styled vector geometry (rounded bars, callout leaders, markers).
- [`subtitleColor`](#subtitlecolor): Chart subtitle text colour.
- [`tabularNums`](#tabularnums): Whether to emit tabular-nums styling for numeric tick and value labels.
- [`titleAlignment`](#titlealignment): Chart title horizontal alignment.
- [`titleColor`](#titlecolor): Chart title text colour.
- [`titleFontFamily`](#titlefontfamily): Chart title font family name.
- [`titleFontSize`](#titlefontsize): Chart title font size in points.
- [`titleX`](#titlex): Optional explicit title X position.
- [`titleY`](#titley): Title baseline Y offset from the top of the chart.
